title: Ya-Sin 36:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 13. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ (٥) لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ (٦) لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ (٧) إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ (٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

questions.q: Chunk and link Ya-Sin 36:5-8 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 36:5-8 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 36:5-8 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, explain what 'heedless' (36:6) means and one way to avoid it.
questions.a: Unaware, not paying attention to Allah's signs; daily dhikr and Qur'an keep the heart awake.

questions.q: Find a madd muttasil, a munfasil and an ikhfa in 36:5 to 8.
questions.a: Muttasil ءَابَآؤُهُمْ (36:6); munfasil مَّآ أُنذِرَ (36:6), عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ (36:7), فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ (36:8); ikhfa تَنزِيلَ, لِتُنذِرَ, أُنذِرَ, أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ.

questions.q: 36:5 calls the Qur'an a revelation of the One who is ...
questions.a: A) Exalted in Might, the Merciful. 36:5: ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ.

questions.q: Ya-Sin 36:7: «لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 36:7 says the word has come true for most of them, so they will not believe. What makes a heart refuse guidance?
questions.a: Heedlessness and arrogance; 36:6 describes a people heedless, never warned before.
